final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT orderslink, AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_rebate, AVG(1.0 * rebrate / NULLIF(feerate, 0)) AS avg_rate_ratio FROM fees WHERE rebrate >= 0.0005 GROUP BY orderslink), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_rate_ratio) AS overall_avg FROM step1) SELECT step1.orderslink, step1.avg_rebate, step1.avg_rate_ratio, step1.avg_rate_ratio / NULLIF(step2.overall_avg, 0) AS ratio FROM step1 CROSS JOIN step2 WHERE step2.overall_avg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ratio IS NULL, ratio DESC LIMIT 10
